The dish looks like pico de gallo or salsa fresca: diced tomato, red onion, cilantro, and possibly some mango or pineapple. It sits on a plate roughly 20–22 cm across. The mound covers about 12×10 cm and is moderately heaped, which suggests about 200 g of food. Salsa runs around 25–30 kcal per 100 g, and a little added oil or fruit could push it slightly higher, so the total is about 60 kcal.
